title: TeXplorer browser engineering checks
scope: Curated transcription of existing local timing reports, not a new experiment or an archival NER accuracy benchmark.
host: NVIDIA GB10; headless Chromium; locally served application and model assets
timing: NER worker processing milliseconds, including tokenisation, model execution and decoding; warmed long-fixture runs. Excludes model loading, network downloads, OCR, Python postprocessing and UI rendering.
fixtures: Fixed repeated snippets: roughly 2,000 Finnish characters and 1,500 Estonian characters. Run label: long.
caveats: The single-thread baseline was measured without cross-origin isolation; the four-thread condition was measured in separate isolated runs.
These are small engineering checks, not randomized performance trials or promised laptop timings.
The ten-thread measurements show substantial run-to-run variation.
Provider agreement and general model accuracy must be evaluated separately.

reports.threads_basis: Single-thread fallback without isolation; older report does not contain an explicit threads field.
